publish_desc: The moment a page stops being raw material and enters a chatbot's corpus.
no_runs: No passes recorded for this site yet.
run_truncated: The crawl did not see the whole scope ({{motivo}}): this pass did not check for gone pages.
run_blocked_detail: {{cuantas}} page(s) did not enter the corpus because of blocking findings. The reason for each is in Findings.
run_page_errors: {{cuantas}} page(s) could not be downloaded. Each one is recorded as a finding with its cause.
sections_help: A section that keeps updating itself —conferences, events, grants— is parameterised here, with its own cadence and owner. The first pass is reviewed by hand; after that, automatic mode maintains what was already approved.
no_sections: No sections: the whole site is crawled, as before.
pattern_matches_nothing: This pattern matches no page of the site: check it before saving.
no_findings: No active findings for this site
report_no_findings: No active findings for this site
gaps_hint: Similar questions the assistant could not answer. They usually point at a missing document.
gaps_none: No gaps detected for this chatbot.
site_url_filter_help: Regular expression: only URLs matching it are crawled. One section per site.
site_courtesy_help: The delay and robots.txt compliance are on by default. Lowering them is a decision recorded here.
reason_page_gone: No longer on the portal and this section does not retire on its own: decide whether it leaves the corpus
reason_retirada_masiva_detenida: {{bajas}} of {{ambito}} pages in the section disappeared ({{proporcion}} %): nothing was retired
site_date_help: If the portal publishes a date on each page, where it is. On www.uji.es it is .clockBarDate, with the owning unit next to it. Without this, age is inferred from the year in the URL.
series_policy_superseded: The new one supersedes the old
site_series_help: How this portal publishes. UJI publishes yearly agreements and minutes that all remain valid; another portal versions calls for applications, where the new one replaces the old.
page_content_note: This is the text that would go into the assistant's corpus, without the portal's menu or template. It is not the original page.
page_content_empty: This page has no stored text.
page_content_needs_js: This page could not be read without rendering, so its text may be incomplete.
download_failed: The report could not be downloaded
recon_help: Walks the section up to 3 levels deep without storing anything, to see how many pages there are and what crawling them would cost with the courtesy delay set above.
recon_failed: The site could not be reconnoitered
recon_total: {{urls}} URLs found up to 3 levels ({{sondeadas}} requested)
recon_estimate: Full crawl: about {{minutos}} min, at {{porPagina}} s per page
recon_truncated: The probe stopped early ({{motivo}}): the section may have more pages.
reason_error_not_found: Not found (404): the link points to something that is gone
reason_error_transient: Network or server failure: says nothing about the page
reason_error_client_error: The server answers but does not serve the page (401/403)
reason_series: {{cuantas}} yearly versions of the same resource
reason_needs_js: Only {{tokens}} tokens unrendered: may need JavaScript
reason_needs_js_short: Could not be read without rendering
reason_updated: The portal changed it on {{fecha}} and it was re-ingested
reason_updated_short: The portal changed it and it was re-ingested
ingest_sent: {{count}} page(s) sent for ingestion. It takes a few seconds: ingestion runs in the background.
pdf_unavailable: This server has no LibreOffice, so it cannot generate PDF: the report downloads as Word. Installing LibreOffice on the server brings the PDF button back.
pages_intro: All crawled pages. Tick the ones that should feed the assistant: whoever creates it will see them as proposed in Publication. Proposing publishes nothing.
pages_error: The proposal could not be saved.
